name: SavedView
summary: Named query state with diff + share. Saves a FilterBuilder state under a name. Shows a diff indicator when the current filters differ from the saved state (lime dot). Share via copyable URL. Manage via a popover dropdown — Save / Save as / Rename / Share / Delete.

rules: Visible focus ring required (outline + box-shadow per AGENTS.md hard rule 11).
Color is never the only signal — pair with label, shape, or icon.

dont: NEVER allow duplicate view names without disambiguation.
NEVER skip the dirty indicator (it's the trust signal).
NEVER share without explicit user action.
